status: Complete source-grounded script and art proposal; canonical film unchanged

scenes.title: Useful can still be fragile
lines: A useful AI product can succeed with customers and still lose its independence.
Investing in an AI-Dominated Economy builds its thesis around that uncomfortable distinction.
The book presents the strategic doctrine behind Outfinity Venture Studio.
It asks what a company retains when competitors can rent the same intelligence.
Readers gain a framework for examining that wager, including reasons it could fail.
scenes.artPlan: A buyer receives a useful review report from an independent software team. An existing enterprise suite offers the same visible report function. Keep the buyer and report constant: usefulness persists while the separate supplier faces a retention question. No named company or measured outcome.

scenes.title: What survives the feature?
lines: Imagine a review tool whose main attraction is generating a polished report.
An enterprise suite could bundle that feature into a service customers already use.
The book distinguishes demand for the feature from bargaining power for its supplier.
It asks what each deployment accumulates beyond another sale.
Reusable evaluations and lawful learning rights matter only when they actually strengthen the company.
scenes.artPlan: Close view of the same report inside two procurement options. The independent team inspects a second deployment: validated evaluation cases and reusable methods remain, while confidential customer records stay at the customer. Carry a tested exception from deployment one into deployment two; no automatic ownership or business-success stamp.

scenes.title: Beyond a convincing answer
lines: A report can be fluent while leaving authority and responsibility unresolved.
The business chapters follow work through permissions, checks, decisions, and retained evidence.
A model may change while the project and its authorized history remain.
The proposed business brand would stand behind that continuity across specialized products.
AssistOS is one architectural contribution, rather than the whole commercial strategy.
scenes.artPlan: The report enters a real review workspace: a named role must approve a consequential step; an unchanged decision record stays while the model resource is replaced. Pull back to specialized workstations sharing a baseline, not one AssistOS product swallowing all ventures. Proposed architecture only.

scenes.title: A different social promise
lines: The social chapters ask what makes repeated cooperation credible beyond an attention feed.
Consider a small group with shared work, memory, and rules its members understand.
The book proposes shared brands that independent communities and ventures can carry.
Their common identity must leave meaningful rights, local authority, and practical exit.
This social promise requires a different balance of power from enterprise assurance.
scenes.artPlan: Replace software screens with a small collaborative room. A participant contributes an attributed method to common work; a member leaving retains their legitimate contribution record. Community rules and brand-use conditions remain distinct. No global score, poll-as-governance guarantee, or forced belonging.

scenes.title: Shared research, separate ventures
lines: Outfinity proposes a shared research base supporting those two different brand promises.
Each venture still needs its own buyer, team, and economic logic.
A common component earns its place when it solves a recurring problem.
Confidential data and ownership rights limit what the ventures can share.
The book warns against forcing every company onto one convenient stack.
scenes.artPlan: A research workshop tests a reusable evaluator. Two autonomous teams choose whether it fits their respective tasks. Only the suitable tested component crosses to a venture; protected source records stay behind. Business and social promises appear on separate work surfaces, not interchangeable towers.

scenes.title: Finance what the test reveals
lines: Its venture method increases commitments as technical and commercial evidence improves.
A failed experiment can stop a weak path and preserve useful knowledge.
Patient capital still has to purchase learning, rather than prolonged motion.
The proposed operating culture protects criticism, recorded mistakes, and the right to leave.
Even the studio’s favored thesis must remain open to revision.
scenes.artPlan: A bounded trial fails a declared criterion. The failed venture path closes, its evidence enters the shared research record, and further funds remain unallocated rather than flowing automatically. A critic points to the original prediction; an amended thesis preserves the prior version. No invented financial figures or benchmark.

scenes.title: Read the wager and its limits
lines: This is a thesis about building institutions around AI, not selecting the next popular stock.
Its distinctive question is what research, rights, and responsibility can make durable together.
The book connects that question to venture design, brand governance, and capital allocation.
Its proposed advantages remain conditional, and many experiments may never become independent companies.
Read it to examine what a useful product would need to become a lasting organization.
scenes.artPlan: Return to the opening report and its supplier, now beside the book open to the underwriting questions. Retained method, ownership boundary and accountable service point back to concrete situations already seen. The final choice is whether to read the argument, not buy an asset or join the studio.

scope: 35 single-sentence beats, intended approximately4–5minutes after measured local voice; no sped-up narration
limits: Book claims and proposed architecture, not independently verified market forecasts
No financial instrument recommendations or return claims
Illustrative review-tool situation derives from source platform-bundling and governed-work mechanisms; not a reported customer case
artAcceptance: Do not compose all scenes as documents on the same desk. Use procurement screen close-up, persistent workspace switch, human group, research bench and an experiment decision.
A claim of reuse must show the same attributed test case moving to and being used in a second deployment. A new label alone is insufficient.
In the failed experiment scene, show the original criterion, conflicting observed result and stopped next commitment; preserve the failed record.
Every shared component must have a source and destination; confidential source data stays in its original domain.
